title: Rubric Judgments Lack Uncertainty: Conformal Weighting for LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess large language model (LLM) outputs by decomposing quality into multiple criteria and assigning each a binary judgment from an LLM verifier. However, judgment certainty varies substantially across criteria. Existing methods uniformly aggregate these judgments into a final score, implicitly treating every criterion as equally certain and overlooking this heterogeneity. As a result, uncertain judgments remain incorporated into reward estimation without distinction, potentially yielding misleading training signals for downstream reinforcement learning (RL). To address this limitation, we propose Uncertainty-aware Rubric Weighting (URW), a training-free framework that quantifies criterion-level judgment uncertainty via conformal calibration. translated_title: 评分标准判断缺乏不确定性度量：面向大语言模型评估的保形加权
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的评估被广泛用于评估大语言模型（LLM）的输出，其做法是将输出质量分解为多个标准，并由LLM验证器对每个标准给出二元判断。然而，不同标准之间的判断确定性差异很大。现有方法将这些判断均匀地聚合为最终分数，隐含地把每个标准视为具有同等的确定性，从而忽视了这种异质性。其结果是，不确定性高的判断被不加区分地纳入奖励估计中，可能为下游强化学习（RL）产生误导性的训练信号。为解决这一局限，我们提出了不确定性感知的评分标准加权，这是一个免训练框架，通过保形校准来量化标准层面的判断不确定性。具体而言，URW从一组固定的改写判断模板中引出软不确定性信号，并将其转换为每个标准的权重……
tldr: 提出了一种免训练的不确定性感知评分标准加权框架（URW），通过保形校准量化LLM评估中各评分标准判断的不确定性并据此加权，避免不确定的判断对下游强化学习训练产生误导。
en_tdlr: We propose Uncertainty-aware Rubric Weighting (URW), a training-free framework that quantifies per-criterion judgment uncertainty via conformal calibration and weights rubric judgments accordingly, preventing uncertain judgments from producing misleading training signals for downstream reinforcement learning.
